reason: 该插件的主要用户价值在于为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图表生成能力，帮助智能体基于规范化输入产出可验证的系统架构类可视化成果。证据显示其核心能力集中在五类图形生成、JSON/Mermaid 输入处理、校验（quality 模式）与可交付制品输出（HTML/PNG/SVG/WebM），并带有快照对比功能，属于可视化型技能扩展，而非基础运维或外部服务集成。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 技能，可将结构化 JSON 或 Mermaid 描述转为可验证的架构、流程、时序、数据流和生命周期图，并输出独立 HTML 等交付制品。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness skill that turns structured JSON or Mermaid descriptions into validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams, with deliverable output formats such as standalone HTML.

capabilities: Generate architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, and lifecycle diagrams from JSON specifications
Validate diagram specs with deterministic quality checks before delivery
Convert Mermaid inputs into internal Archify JSON for diagram generation
Export diagrams as standalone HTML and media outputs (PNG/SVG/WebM)
Compare two diagram snapshots to produce before/delta/after views
